tasks.currentSketch: If the Euclidean unit ball is already known to be convex, write (x+y)/(‖x‖+‖y‖) as the convex combination [‖x‖/(‖x‖+‖y‖)]·x/‖x‖+[‖y‖/(‖x‖+‖y‖)]·y/‖y‖. tasks.entryDescription: Bezout identity; Euclid's gcd lemma; prime elements in a UFD/irreducible-is-prime in a PID.
tasks.currentSketch: If prime p divides ab but not a, then gcd(p,a)=1. Bézout gives rp+sa=1; multiply by b: rpb+sab=b. Both terms on the right representation are divisible by p, so p|b.
